paragraphs: Rav Acha Salla, grandson of Rav Acha Salla the great, said in Abaye’s name, end of Ketubbot. He encountered another reading: there, 111a, “The righteous outside the Land live through rolling through underground passages.” Rabbi Abay Salla Rabba objects, “Rolling through passages is painful!” Abaye says passages are made for them. Perhaps Abaye never saw him, but answered his objection (see Abba).
